x1.reason: One size's transcripts filed under another size's name, same condition. Not in the committed data (each pair's run file and report agree, and replay rebuilds byte for byte); needs a per-pair transcript digest in the run file.
x1.fix: Record the transcripts file's sha256 and the Whisper size and revision in each run file at transcription; evaluate_pair and the committed-report test refuse a mismatch.

x2.reason: Reuse is counted before the gateway serves the read, so a budget-refused read is miscounted. Only reachable when a record pass is refused by the budget guard; the committed passes have none (paid + reused equals successful calls for all six).
x2.fix: Count reuse only after the gateway returns a cached answer; a refused read counts as unanswered.

x3.reason: SIGTERM between a billed read and the next checkpoint leaves that charge off the run file. Ctrl-C and Python exceptions are handled; only an uncatchable kill loses one read's spend (about $0.0003).
x3.fix: Install a SIGTERM handler that writes the checkpoint, or checkpoint before each paid call with a reservation.

x4.reason: Two record passes on the same pair at once can overwrite each other's checkpoint. The runner is operated by one person, one pass per pair at a time; nothing runs it concurrently.
x4.fix: Take a lock file per pair for the length of a record pass, or append checkpoints by pass id instead of by index.

x5.reason: A transcription against a stale manifest is caught only when reads start, not at transcription. Replay still refuses the rows, so nothing wrong can be published.
x5.fix: Check the manifest digests at the end of transcription, before publishing the two files.

x6.reason: An unrelated JSONL file in evals/voice/transcripts breaks text evals in record mode with a KeyError. The folder holds only the six pair files, and the secret scan now flags anything else there.
x6.fix: In SyntheticIndex, read only the six named pair files and skip others.
